source_policy: Keep upstream Git checkout pristine. Build a separate copy with exactly one additional vector include in extractor/suffix_table.hpp. Verify every other source file unchanged.
warning_policy: Inherit v8 exact source scopes without additional suppression
header_audit: Lexical inventory is candidate discovery only; CMake File API identifies four-target dependency closure; bounded standalone compiler probes must pass before full compilation. No automatic additional includes.
negative_probe_policy: Original coordinate/suffix probes may intentionally fail; corrected probes and target-header preflight are mandatory
